REM-SSH-01.objective: Enforce SSHv2 and disable SSHv1 on Cisco IOS/IOS-XE
REM-SSH-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
ip domain name enterprise.net
crypto key generate rsa modulus 4096
ip ssh version 2
ip ssh time-out 60
ip ssh authentication-retries 3
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
end
write memory
REM-SSH-01.before_example:
line vty 0 4
 transport input telnet ssh
REM-SSH-01.after_example:
ip ssh version 2
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
REM-SSH-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
line vty 0 15
 transport input all
end
REM-SSH-01.explanation: Generates 4096-bit RSA keys, mandates SSHv2 protocol, sets 60s handshake timeout, and locks VTY lines to SSH.

REM-TELNET-01.objective: Disable Telnet protocol across all VTY transport lines
REM-TELNET-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
 transport output none
end
write memory
REM-TELNET-01.before_example:
line vty 0 4
 transport input telnet ssh
REM-TELNET-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
line vty 0 15
 transport input telnet ssh
end
REM-TELNET-01.explanation: Removes telnet from allowed transport protocols on virtual terminal lines.

REM-HTTP-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
no ip http server
ip http secure-server
end
write memory
REM-HTTP-01.after_example:
no ip http server
ip http secure-server
REM-HTTP-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
ip http server
end
REM-HTTP-01.explanation: Shuts down cleartext port 80 web management daemon.

REM-HTTPS-01.objective: Enable secure HTTPS server with TLS
REM-HTTPS-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
ip http secure-server
ip http secure-ciphersuite aes-256-cbc-sha
end
write memory
REM-HTTPS-01.verification_command: show ip http server secure status
REM-HTTPS-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
no ip http secure-server
end
REM-HTTPS-01.explanation: Activates TLS encrypted administrative web portal.

REM-SNMP-01.objective: Configure SNMPv3 with authPriv and remove default communities
REM-SNMP-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
snmp-server group SECGROUP v3 priv
snmp-server user secadmin SECGROUP v3 auth sha-256 AuthPass2026! priv aes 256 PrivPass2026!
end
write memory
REM-SNMP-01.after_example:
snmp-server group SECGROUP v3 priv
snmp-server user secadmin SECGROUP v3 auth sha-256 ... priv aes 256 ...
REM-SNMP-01.verification_command:
show snmp group
show snmp user
REM-SNMP-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
no snmp-server user secadmin SECGROUP v3
no snmp-server group SECGROUP v3
end
REM-SNMP-01.explanation: Removes standard community strings and creates an authenticated and encrypted SNMPv3 security group.

REM-LOG-01.objective: Configure centralized syslog logging with millisecond timestamps
REM-LOG-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone
logging buffered 64000 informational
logging host 10.100.20.50 transport udp port 514
logging trap informational
logging source-interface Loopback0
end
write memory
REM-LOG-01.before_example:
no logging buffered
! no logging host configured
REM-LOG-01.after_example:
service timestamps log datetime msec
logging host 10.100.20.50
logging trap informational
REM-LOG-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
no logging host 10.100.20.50
end
REM-LOG-01.explanation: Redirects informational and higher audit records to enterprise SIEM collector.

REM-NTP-01.cli_command:

end

REM-NTP-01.rollback_command:

REM-AAA-01.objective: Enforce centralized AAA authentication via TACACS+/RADIUS
REM-AAA-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
aaa new-model
tacacs server TACACS-SRV
 address ipv4 10.100.30.15
 key 6 C1ph3rX!S3cur3K3y
aaa group server tacacs+ TACACS-GRP
 server name TACACS-SRV
aaa authentication login default group TACACS-GRP local
aaa authorization exec default group TACACS-GRP local
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group TACACS-GRP
end
write memory
REM-AAA-01.before_example:
no aaa new-model
username admin password 0 admin
REM-AAA-01.after_example:
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default group TACACS-GRP local
REM-AAA-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
no aaa new-model
end
REM-AAA-01.explanation: Activates AAA framework and establishes TACACS+ cluster authentication with local emergency fallback.

REM-PASS-01.objective: Enforce minimum 15-character password length and SHA-512 secret hashing
REM-PASS-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
security passwords min-length 15
enable algorithm-type sha-512 secret StrongEnableSecret2026!
end
write memory
REM-PASS-01.after_example:
security passwords min-length 15
enable algorithm-type sha-512 secret ...
REM-PASS-01.verification_command: show running-config | include security passwords|enable algorithm
REM-PASS-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
security passwords min-length 6
end
REM-PASS-01.explanation: Mandates 15-character length threshold and replaces legacy MD5/Type 7 secrets with salted Type 9 SHA-512 hashes.

REM-TIMEOUT-01.objective: Set 10-minute administrative inactivity timeout on all management lines
REM-TIMEOUT-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
line con 0
 exec-timeout 10 0
line vty 0 15
 exec-timeout 10 0
end
write memory
REM-TIMEOUT-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
line vty 0 15
 exec-timeout 30 0
end
REM-TIMEOUT-01.explanation: Sets 10 min 0 sec inactivity limit on console and VTY lines.

REM-CRYPTO-01.objective: Disable weak ciphers and enforce AES-256-GCM / SHA-512
REM-CRYPTO-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
ip ssh server algorithm encryption aes256-ctr aes192-ctr aes128-ctr
ip ssh server algorithm mac hmac-sha2-512 hmac-sha2-256
end
write memory
REM-CRYPTO-01.after_example: ip ssh server algorithm encryption aes256-ctr ...
REM-CRYPTO-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
no ip ssh server algorithm encryption
end
REM-CRYPTO-01.explanation: Restricts SSH encryption and integrity to AES-CTR and HMAC-SHA2.

REM-UNUSED-01.objective: Disable unnecessary small servers and finger services
REM-UNUSED-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
no service finger
no service pad
no service udp-small-servers
no service tcp-small-servers
no ip bootp server
end
write memory
REM-UNUSED-01.after_example:
no service finger
no service pad
no service udp-small-servers
no service tcp-small-servers
REM-UNUSED-01.explanation: Closes legacy utility ports and deactivates unused auxiliary daemons.

REM-MGMT-01.objective: Isolate management plane into dedicated VRF and configure Control Plane Policing
REM-MGMT-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
vrf definition MGMT
 address-family ipv4
 exit-address-family
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 vrf forwarding MGMT
 ip address 192.168.100.2 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
control-plane
 service-policy input CoPP-Policy
end
write memory
REM-MGMT-01.after_example:
vrf definition MGMT
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 vrf forwarding MGMT
REM-MGMT-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 no vrf forwarding MGMT
end
REM-MGMT-01.explanation: Separates control/management plane traffic from routing data plane.

REM-ACL-01.objective: Bind interface ACLs with explicit default deny and logging
REM-ACL-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
ip access-list extended INGRESS-FILTER
 permit tcp any any established
 permit tcp 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255 host 10.100.1.1 eq 22
 deny ip any any log-input
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip access-group INGRESS-FILTER in
end
write memory
REM-ACL-01.after_example:
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip access-group INGRESS-FILTER in
REM-ACL-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 no ip access-group INGRESS-FILTER in
end
REM-ACL-01.explanation: Enforces boundary traffic inspection with explicit deny-all logging.

REM-FW-01.objective: Enable Zone-Based Firewall inspection and drop unassigned traffic
REM-FW-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
zone security INSIDE
zone security OUTSIDE
zone-pair security ZP-IN-OUT source INSIDE destination OUTSIDE
 service-policy type inspect ZBFW-POLICY
end
write memory
REM-FW-01.after_example:
zone security INSIDE
zone-pair security ZP-IN-OUT ...
REM-FW-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
no zone-pair security ZP-IN-OUT
end
REM-FW-01.explanation: Instantiates stateful protocol inspection between security zones.

REM-REMOTE-01.objective: Configure IKEv2 and strong AES-GCM cipher suites for VPN tunnels
REM-REMOTE-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
crypto ikev2 proposal IKEV2-STRONG
 encryption aes-gcm-256
 prf sha384
 group 19 20
end
write memory
REM-REMOTE-01.before_example:
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encr 3des
 hash md5
REM-REMOTE-01.after_example:
crypto ikev2 proposal IKEV2-STRONG
 encryption aes-gcm-256
REM-REMOTE-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
no crypto ikev2 proposal IKEV2-STRONG
end
REM-REMOTE-01.explanation: Upgrades IPsec phase 1 to IKEv2 with elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman groups.

login on-failure log
login on-success log
end
write memory
REM-AUTH-01.rollback_command:

end
REM-AUTH-01.explanation: Blocks administrative login attempts for 5 minutes after 3 failures in 60 seconds.

REM-ROUTING-01.objective: Configure MD5/SHA neighbor authentication on BGP & OSPF sessions
REM-ROUTING-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
router bgp 65001
 neighbor 192.168.1.1 password 8 BGP$3cur3P@ss!
 neighbor 192.168.1.1 ttl-security hops 2
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip ospf message-digest-key 1 md5 OSPF$3cur3K3y!
end
write memory
REM-ROUTING-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
router bgp 65001
 no neighbor 192.168.1.1 password
end
REM-ROUTING-01.explanation: Protects dynamic routing sessions from unauthorized route injection or spoofing.

REM-IFSEC-01.objective: Enable Port Security, BPDU Guard, and Storm Control on edge switchports
REM-IFSEC-01.cli_command:
configure terminal
interface range GigabitEthernet1/0/1 - 24
 switchport mode access
 switchport port-security
 switchport port-security maximum 2
 switchport port-security violation shutdown
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
 storm-control broadcast level 5.00
end
write memory
REM-IFSEC-01.after_example:
switchport port-security
spanning-tree bpduguard enable
storm-control broadcast level 5.00
REM-IFSEC-01.rollback_command:
configure terminal
interface range GigabitEthernet1/0/1 - 24
 no switchport port-security
 no spanning-tree bpduguard enable
end
REM-IFSEC-01.explanation: Mitigates MAC address flooding, rogue switch STP root hijack, and broadcast storms.
